evals.prompt: Build a landing page for a B2B invoicing SaaS aimed at finance teams. Tone should be serious and trustworthy.
evals.expected_output: Should start with a one-line Design Read (page kind, audience, vibe, aesthetic family), avoid LLM defaults (AI-purple gradients, centered hero over dark mesh, three equal feature cards, Inter + slate-900), and pick an aesthetic that fits serious B2B buyers.
assertions: Outputs a one-line Design Read before any code
Design Read names page kind, audience, vibe and aesthetic family
Avoids AI-purple gradients and generic dark-mesh centered hero
Avoids three equal feature cards as the default layout
Aesthetic choice fits a serious B2B finance audience

evals.prompt: Redesign our homepage. Not sure yet if we want a full overhaul or just a refresh, and I have no strong opinion on style.
evals.expected_output: Should ask exactly one clarifying question about the genuinely divergent decision (e.g. Linear-clean vs Awwwards-experimental, preserve vs overhaul) instead of guessing or dumping multiple questions.
assertions: Asks exactly one clarifying question, not a multi-question dump
Question targets the genuinely divergent decision (preserve vs overhaul or aesthetic direction)
Does not guess the design direction silently
Does not jump to code before resolving the ambiguity

evals.prompt: Audit-first redesign: our agency portfolio homepage converts poorly. It currently uses a generic hero, glassmorphism cards everywhere, and infinite-loop micro-animations.
evals.expected_output: Should run an audit-first pass identifying the templated patterns (generic glassmorphism, scattered micro-animations), read existing brand assets as starting material, and propose a direction grounded in the agency's real work.
assertions: Runs audit before proposing the redesign
Flags generic glassmorphism applied everywhere as a problem
Flags scattered infinite-loop micro-animations as a problem
Treats existing brand assets (logo, color, type, photography) as starting material
Runs the strict pre-flight check before shipping
